sentence_of_record: TREE-LIKE (2026-10-04, 0 calls) — VALID; TL0 PASS, TL1 MIXED, F-TL NOT FIRED. Against the moment-matched Gaussian null, qwen3 (native) is Gromov-tree-like on CLINC (5 of 5 subsamples, z -2.5 to -3.6) and not on MASSIVE (0 of 5) by the registered max-four-point estimator. A flat cluster mixture also reads tree-like under this test, so neither corpus's reading is evidence of hierarchy, and MIXED is not 'CLINC is hierarchical, MASSIVE is flat'. F-TL did not fire: the test does not show that a tree imposed on MASSIVE / CLINC is an artefact. plain_description.what: Measures whether intent-dataset embeddings (CLINC, MASSIVE; qwen3 embedder) are geometrically tree-like (Gromov delta and related measures). This is compared with a Gaussian null of matched mean and covariance, after a planted-hierarchy positive control. No calls.
plain_description.why: Asks whether the embedding space has hierarchy beyond its covariance, or whether any tree built on it is imposed by the algorithm.
plain_description.information: Not tree-like would mean the hierarchy is an artefact. Tree-like would support, but not prove, hierarchy. Result: done, mixed. CLINC reads tree-like in 5 of 5 subsamples, MASSIVE in 0 of 5. But a flat cluster mixture also reads tree-like under this test, so neither reading is evidence of hierarchy, and it is not 'CLINC hierarchical, MASSIVE flat'. The falsifier did not fire. The MMLU-Pro arm was not run.
